question.zh-CN: 怎样把电能变成可控的力与运动，并在冲击、温升和磨损下保持性能？
question.en: How is electrical energy converted into controllable force and motion under impact, heat and wear?

problem.zh-CN: 提供可调的力矩与转速。

research.zh-CN: 力矩密度、反驱性与驱控协同设计。

industry.zh-CN: 热设计、绕组制造与一致性。
industry.en: Thermal design, winding production and consistency.

compare.zh-CN: 持续与峰值力矩、效率曲线、温升。
compare.en: Continuous versus peak torque, efficiency curves and heating.

problem.zh-CN: 在体积约束下放大力矩。
problem.en: Multiply torque within a compact envelope.

research.zh-CN: 摩擦、回差补偿与传动柔性建模。
research.en: Friction, backlash compensation and compliance modeling.

industry.zh-CN: 寿命、精度、冲击承载与批次差异。
industry.en: Life, precision, impact tolerance and batch variation.

compare.zh-CN: 减速比、回差、刚度与疲劳工况。
compare.en: Ratio, backlash, stiffness and fatigue conditions.

problem.zh-CN: 产生直线推力与精密位移。
problem.en: Generate linear thrust and precise displacement.

research.zh-CN: 非线性摩擦、载荷估计与结构优化。
research.en: Nonlinear friction, load estimation and structural optimization.

industry.zh-CN: 润滑、密封、安装与轴向寿命。
industry.en: Lubrication, sealing, mounting and axial life.

compare.zh-CN: 额定推力、行程、速度与工作循环。
compare.en: Rated thrust, stroke, speed and duty cycle.

problem.zh-CN: 把电机、传动、驱动与传感封装为关节。
problem.en: Package motor, transmission, drive and sensing as a joint.

research.zh-CN: 模块化本体与动力学辨识。

industry.zh-CN: 线束、散热、总线与更换效率。
industry.en: Wiring, heat removal, buses and replacement effort.

compare.zh-CN: 关节接口、质量、持续输出与总线时延。
compare.en: Joint interface, mass, sustained output and bus latency.

problem.zh-CN: 把电流、速度与位置指令稳定执行。
problem.en: Execute current, velocity and position commands stably.

research.zh-CN: 高带宽控制、扰动观测与力矩估计。
research.en: High-bandwidth control, disturbance observers and torque estimation.

industry.zh-CN: 保护机制、实时性与参数整定。

compare.zh-CN: 控制周期、抖动、反馈分辨率。
compare.en: Control period, jitter and feedback resolution.

problem.zh-CN: 保障关节承载、停机保持与运动供能。
problem.en: Support loads, hold safely at rest and route moving power.

research.zh-CN: 接触磨损、失效预测与轻量结构。
research.en: Contact wear, failure prediction and lightweight structures.

industry.zh-CN: 轴承、制动器、拖链、线束与密封配套。
industry.en: Bearings, brakes, cable carriers, harnesses and seals.

compare.zh-CN: 承载寿命、弯折寿命、防护与维护周期。
compare.en: Load life, flex life, protection and service intervals.
